question: What are the key catalysts for Diginex?

beats.line: Diginex faces execution milestones that decide whether the platform consolidation thesis gains traction or stalls.
beats.headline: MILESTONES
subjects: a row of paper milestone cards
beats.action: A row of halftone paper milestone cards drops in one by one and locks into a straight line.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex faces execution milestones that decide whether the platform consolidation thesis gains traction or stalls.

connector.from: a row of paper milestone cards

beats.line: The company committed to further updates on its unified business strategy over the course of the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.
beats.headline: Q2 2026
subjects: a row of paper milestone cards
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the milestone row folds forward into a single paper calendar page; a violet ribbon runs from the row to the page, and a coin-sized cream tag reading 'Q2 2026' sits beside the ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: The company committed to further updates on its unified business strategy over the course of the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.

connector.from: a row of paper milestone cards

beats.line: Investors want cross-sell traction and a path to the two hundred and eighty million dollar group revenue target by twenty twenty-seven.
beats.headline: $280M BY 2027
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the calendar page tears into a rising paper bar chart; a paper hand taps the tallest bar, and the violet ribbon stays in place across the frame.
beats.delivery: Investors want cross-sell traction and a path to the two hundred and eighty million dollar group revenue target by twenty twenty-seven.

connector.from: a row of paper milestone cards

beats.line: Watch whether the four acquired businesses run as one platform rather than separate silos.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bar chart flattens into four paper tiles that slide together onto the paper platform slab.
beats.delivery: Watch whether the four acquired businesses run as one platform rather than separate silos.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the transformative bet. Cross-sell evidence decides it.
beats.headline: $1.5B BET
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top as the platform slab thickens under one enlarged tile; the cyan arrow already runs from the tiles to the slab, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$1.5B' sits beside it, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] The one point five billion dollar Resulticks deal is the transformative bet. Cross-sell evidence decides it.

beats.line: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market offers a new revenue stream beyond core markets.
beats.headline: $77B MARKET
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as one edge of the platform slab unfolds into a cut paper map that settles beside it; the cyan arrow holds.
beats.delivery: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market offers a new revenue stream beyond core markets.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year to two million dollars, driven mainly by subscription.
beats.headline: 293% YOY
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the paper map creases upward into a paper bar chart; a lime ribbon runs from the chart to a stack of paper coins, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '293%' sits beside the ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: [excited] Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent year on year to two million dollars, driven mainly by subscription.

beats.line: October's warrant exercise generated thirteen point eight million in cash, removing near-term funding pressure.
beats.headline: $13.8M CASH
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bar chart's tallest column tips over into a stack of paper coins that grows and settles; the lime ribbon stays in place.
beats.delivery: October's warrant exercise generated thirteen point eight million in cash, removing near-term funding pressure.

beats.line: At a thirty-four million dollar market cap, Diginex is priced for significant scepticism.
beats.headline: $34M CAP
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the coin stack compresses into one small paper market-cap block; a paper hand presses down on it and holds.
beats.delivery: At a thirty-four million dollar market cap, Diginex is priced for significant scepticism.

beats.line: The next six to nine months are make-or-break for the investment thesis.
beats.headline: 6–9 MONTHS
subjects: a row of paper milestone cards
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge as the market-cap block unfolds back into the row of paper milestone cards, now with a torn paper strip laid across the last card; a black string runs from the block to the row, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '6–9 months' sits beside it, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: The next six to nine months are make-or-break for the investment thesis.
